verdict.rationale: Productboard publishes a per-endpoint API reference at developer.productboard.com/reference (e.g. list/create/delete webhook pages), plus a quickstart for making a first authenticated call. Runnable exploration is offered through a Postman workflow, which is an external tool rather than an in-browser interactive console, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. missing for 10: evidence of an in-page interactive 'try it' console, runnable code samples embedded in the reference, a public OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
